title: Akiyama Mizuki — Between Feelings And Reality〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuuum♪
I got me a super cute dress♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The lace pattern on the midriff looks a little clunky, but I guess I can just fix that myself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So it's off to the sewing lounge!
I hope there's space... Hm, is that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, it's not this way either...
The map said there should be an alley here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Shizuku...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku!
We haven't seen each other since our picnic, have we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki!
Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm trying to get to this place here on the map, but I'm not sure how. Would you happen to know, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure, let's see... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh, Shizuku...
This is a map of London...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I know!
I'm trying to find a store called London...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I looked up London and Map and this was what I found so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, now I get it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Shizuku...
This map won't get you to the store you're looking for. It's not even a map of Shibuya...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a map of London, UK, you see...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Who would've thought that we were actually headed for the same place?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And this place being named Lond and not London probably didn't help either...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I didn't know that you liked embroidering, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, my grandmother taught me how.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's so cool! Do you ever make your own clothes and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that I can, but I'm not very good with sewing machines or machines in general. I think that's why I prefer embroidery more since its much simpler...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So today, I'd like to finish making this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A handkerchief with... Is that someone's name...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I plan to give everyone in my group one. Each will have their own name and MORE MORE JUMP! sewn into them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This one's for Haruka...
I'm having their names be in their own color, but our group name will have the same design.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, that's amazing...! The letters are so tiny! You even gave your group name a cool color gradient too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
It was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope your alterations go well too, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! It's time to give this thing a cute makeover!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shizuku, is my sewing machine being too loud?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you're fine. I actually kind of like that sound.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It reminds me of how my grandmother used to make clothes for me and my little sister. It's very nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She did? That's really nice of her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, did someone teach you how to sew and do alterations like this, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I learned it all on my own by looking up stuff, watching videos and copying what people did online.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You learned to do all this by yourself? That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, this is nothing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, by the way...
Did you know that there's a nice, little handicraft shop with a fairly large selection here in Shibuya?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One of my little sister's childhood friends told me about it, and I always seem to find myself completely immersed in all the threads and fabrics they have available.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You mean the place on the second floor of that one building? Yeah, I go there all the time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I didn't realize Shizuku and I had this much in common!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew... Finally, it's done!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the lace on the midriff looks very nice. Almost as if a professional made it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Replacing that bit was a challenge, but I'm glad that it turned out as cute as I hoped it would...♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How'd yours go, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Very well. I have one for each member of my group now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Can I see...?
Oh, I like what you did with the reverse side! This is so nice...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's my thanks for everything they've done for me until now. Each stitch represents just how much I appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you can really tell too!
Honestly, I'm pretty jealous that everyone in your group gets to have one of these...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like to have this one?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I actually brought an extra handkerchief, and worked on it hoping to give it to you once I was done.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It has my name and a blue bird with a ribbon embroidered in...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This bird's wearing the same ribbon as me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A-Are you sure, Shizuku? I can really have this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. You helped me find this place and I had a wonderful time with you today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It would make me very happy if you accept it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow...! Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, by the way...
I get the ribbon motif, but why a blue bird?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really like little birdies and are probably my favorite thing to embroider. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's symbolizes my hope that you'll find your way to happiness, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It does...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know what to say. Thank you so much, Shizuku. I promise to take good care of this...!
